hope: Spend 3 Hope to transform into a Beastform without marking a Stress; choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of it.

features.name: Beastform
features.short: Mark a Stress to transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list (see SRD for the forms); drop out at any time or when you mark your last Hit Point. While transformed you can’t use weapons or cast domain card spells (spells already cast persist; you can still use other features and talk normally). You gain the Beastform’s features, add its Evasion bonus, and attack with its trait. Your armor becomes part of your body: mark Armor Slots as usual; they stay marked when you drop out.

features.name: Wildtouch
features.short: Perform harmless, subtle nature effects at will (grow a flower, a gust of wind, a campfire).

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Incarnation
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: Mark a Stress to Channel an element until you take Severe damage or next rest (see the Elements table on the domain card sheet).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: Adversaries in Melee range that damage you take 1d10 magic damage.

rows.name: Earth
rows.short: Add your Proficiency to your damage thresholds.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When you damage an adversary in Melee range, all others within Very Close range mark a Stress.

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Aura
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: Once per rest while Channeling, assume an aura affecting targets within Close range until Channeling ends (see the Elements table).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: Adversaries that mark Hit Points also mark a Stress.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When an adversary damages you, mark a Stress to move them anywhere within Very Close range of where they are.

rows.name: Air
rows.short: When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond Melee range, reduce it by 1d8.

druid.warden-of-the-elements.name: Elemental Dominion
druid.warden-of-the-elements.short: While Channeling, gain your element’s benefit (see the Elements table).

rows.name: Fire
rows.short: +1 Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage.

rows.name: Earth
rows.short: When you would mark Hit Points, roll a d6 per Hit Point; each 6 reduces the number marked by 1.

rows.name: Water
rows.short: When an attack against you succeeds, mark a Stress to make the attacker temporarily Vulnerable.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Clarity of Nature
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Once per long rest, create a space of natural serenity within Close range. After a few minutes resting there, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, split as you choose between you and allies.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Regeneration
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Touch a creature and spend 3 Hope: it clears 1d4 Hit Points.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Regenerative Reach
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Regeneration can target creatures within Very Close range.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Warden’s Protection
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: Once per long rest, spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on 1d4 allies within Close range.

druid.warden-of-renewal.name: Defender
druid.warden-of-renewal.short: In Beastform, when an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, mark a Stress to reduce the number they mark by 1.
